take: Per the teams' announcements, Seattle traded center Shane Wright to Nashville for right wing Matthew Wood, a one-for-one swap. Both play about 14 minutes a night and sit near the same 5-on-5 chance share (47% for Wright, 47% for Wood). Wright has scored 3 goals to Wood's 1 in 14 games each, and his expected goals (a measure of chance quality) are 3.74 to Wood's 3.12. Seattle's team numbers improve slightly with Wright on the ice, while Nashville's barely move with Wood.
